reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common_contract.population: Only the twelve individually authored directions below. Seven native capsules and twelve located rows are inquiry inputs; neither their cross-product nor a count creates an admission.
common_contract.actual_use: An actual integrated subject or result is consumed for a forecast, real supplied dependency, transition, recovery, fielded-support or assurance-strength decision; the reverse independently requires an actual condition from that function to be consumed by integration. Shared vocabulary, possible future vendors and generic process proximity are insufficient.
common_contract.partial_input: One relevant result, dependency or condition may matter before the receiving property wholly succeeds. A failed necessary same-scoped condition can challenge a particular premise while other conditions remain unknown. Technical health, forecast accuracy, authority, recoverability and whole continuing capability remain distinct.
common_contract.adequacy: An already adequate current input is still a satisfied material input, with no extra platform or execution required. Removing a carrier or meeting differs from removing the function. Complete justified analysis can answer a technical question without itself performing real mainline integration.
common_contract.evidence_kind: Nine old C27 views reuse five dependent observations of real finite component composition. Five old C26 views reference four of seven observations in a separate recovery construction. They were never executed as one integrated recovery system. No actual supplier, forecast, field deployment, legal right, operational decision or cost effect is instantiated.
common_contract.history: All earlier assignments, 476 examined unknowns and their discriminators, missing originals, failures and UNKNOWN terminals remain exact. The I010 storage-failed recorder and fresh authorized first source invocation remain distinct. No old scientific source is rerun or imported.

directions.shared_object: A current combined technical state or actual interaction failure used to update a real plan or estimate.

directions.source_contribution: A reproducible combined result distinguishes integrated work from separately completed branches. A credible interaction failure exposes remaining work or invalidates a completion assumption; a pass narrows only its tested uncertainty.
directions.receiving_consequence: The planner can update assumptions, remaining-work risks or the next learning action rather than treating local green or nominal percent complete as a finished integrated increment.
directions.remaining_premises: Actual work scope, capacity, dependencies, reference information, uncertainty calibration and honest distinction between target, forecast and commitment. A technical result supplies no elapsed effort or completion date by itself.
directions.positive_witness: C27 records two local passes before joining, then mixed output300 against required3. A forecast that actually counted that integration as complete has a contradicted premise; coherent output3 supports only its named technical condition.
directions.nontrigger_or_counterexample: A plan unrelated to this combination, a merge counter used as productivity, or a green badge treated as a delivery-date guarantee does not receive the justified input. One sample cannot establish estimate accuracy.
directions.cheap_alternative_and_removal: A short direct update using the existing current result can suffice. Removing all true integration-status information loses this actual; removing the reporting platform while retaining an honest note does not.
directions.reentry: Revisit on changed scope, composition, forecast horizon, dependency or evidence validity.

Independently, C26 code-only revert loses annotation and snapshot-after-effect restores records but retains a declared effect marker. A technically coherent combination is therefore only a partial recovery input, not a claim that these worlds were jointly executed.
